verdicts.reason: A: the SOLSTICE wordmark is stranded off-axis under the circle, and the heading, body, badges and CTA all sit on different left/right edges. The badges are jammed against each other and the right edge, and the CTA is right-aligned and offset from the copy. The result reads as scattered and ragged. B: it has a clear top-to-bottom flow of brand, headline, product, body, then a CTA row, and the product is large and centered. Flaws: the headline is indented and not aligned with the left margin or the centered brand, the CTA is a small button in a row with the badges so it is not dominant, and the CTA text is tiny. Dead space between the body and the buttons.
